description:
PROBLEM TYPE: LP
PROBLEM INFO:

- A quantity y is known to depend on another quantity x. A set of corresponding values has been collected for x and y and is presented.
- The \var{k}-th y value takes \var{y_{k}} and the \var{k}-th x value takes \var{x_{k}}.

INPUT FORMAT:

{
    "y": [y_{k} for k = 1,...,K],
    "x": [x_{k} for k = 1,...,K]
}


OBJECTIVE: Fit the ‘best’ straight line y = bx + a to this set of data points. The objective is to minimise the sum of absolute deviations of each observed value of y from the value predicted by the linear relationship.

OUTPUT INFO:

- \var{intercept} represents the intercept of the fitted line
- \var{slope} represents the slope of the fitted line

OUTPUT FORMAT:

{
    "intercept": intercept,
    "slope": slope
}

Y.definition: Observed values of the dependent variable

X.definition: Observed values of the independent variable

objective.description: "Minimize the sum of absolute deviations between the observed values of y and the values predicted by the linear function y = bx + a"

constraints.description: For each k = 1,...,K: y_k - (slope * x_k + intercept) <= d_k
constraints.formulation: $\\forall k = 1, \\dots, K:\\; Y_k - (slope \\cdot X_k + intercept) \\le d_k$

constraints.description: For each k = 1,...,K: (slope * x_k + intercept) - y_k <= d_k
constraints.formulation: $\\forall k = 1, \\dots, K:\\; slope \\cdot X_k + intercept - Y_k \\le d_k$

d.definition: Absolute deviation variable for each data point k

slope.definition: Slope of the fitted straight line

intercept.definition: Intercept of the fitted straight line
